name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: Hierarchy navigation, from the root to the current page.

motionProfile.reason: Breadcrumb keeps destination identity while the trail grows, shrinks or renames: changed crumbs and separators fade, retained ancestors reflow toward the final path, the list owns its content-driven block size, and plain labels replace only their changed graphemes under one scoped foreground owner.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: The list owns its own opacity entrance and every crumb owns the opacity channel of its retained host; nothing is repainted by a wrapper.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: A removed crumb keeps only an inert, aria-hidden visual at its last committed box until its native removal completes.

layout.move/one-shot.reason: Each surviving crumb projects its own previous box; the list measures once and never writes a crumb transform.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: The list owns its content-driven block height after a committed path revision; passive viewport or font wrapping stays native.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Link, page, separator and ellipsis each own their own foreground clock; an unprovable caller palette settles that region immediately.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: A direct plain link or page label replaces only its changed graphemes; rich children and render callbacks keep their own structure.
